scope: Synthetic HTML-only design; no company runtime or Power BI speed assertion
checks: Useful default: Community Market, Abbott and Ex-factory ADS share the graph and table.
Desktop selector sits on the left below periods and scope; hiding it preserves the data and expands the review.
One click on/off and keyboard Space keep buttons, plotted lines and table rows synchronized without selecting children automatically.
Value updates amount charts and table together; share/factor retain a separate percentage graph.
58 reconciliation comparisons: Community split, seven Contracts channels, eleven ADS leaves, net IMS, weighted percentages and FY=YTD+YTG; blanks/zero preserved.
Two-column channel/subchannel buttons retain parent context; search selects matches only; lean lines show full parent and child values, with no bar mode.
Combined, driver and sector scope totals agree; multiple cycles remain separately labelled.
Calendar changes preserve FY/YTD/YTG totals; Monthly follows the visible calendars and leaves summary choices intact.
Cross-series hover markers and touch-pinned details work.
Responsive/light-dark rendering, empty selections and warm local interactions pass without JavaScript errors or network requests.
385 raw/formatted cells match the preserved R01 design across five scope, cycle, unit and table scenarios.
